chars.AHMED: AHMED: a slim Moroccan man in his late twenties with short curly black hair and a neatly trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a small black anime-style patch on the chest, light blue jeans, white sneakers and a black crossbody bag
chars.GIRLS: GIRLS: two young Japanese women in their early twenties, one with a short black bob wearing a pastel pink cardigan and a pleated beige skirt, the other with long straight hair wearing an oversized light denim jacket and carrying a white tote bag

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: AHMED proudly places a red Moroccan fez (tarbouche) with a black tassel on his head in front of the mirror of a small modern Japanese business hotel room in Tokyo, chest out, big proud smile, adjusting the tassel. 2D cartoon illustration, warm colors, main subjects in the center of the vertical frame, calm background at the edges, no text.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: On a modern Tokyo street in Japan with Japanese shop signs without readable text, paper lanterns and vending machines: the GIRLS point excitedly at AHMED and squeal loudly with wide open mouths and sparkling eyes, while AHMED, wearing a red Moroccan fez (tarbouche) with a black tassel, freezes in shock with wide eyes and a nervous smile. 2D cartoon illustration, warm colors, main subjects in the center of the vertical frame, calm background at the edges, no text.
